# `nlink-lab snapshot save`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Save a checkpoint of the lab

Usage: nlink-lab snapshot save [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>
          Snapshot name (letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`)

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --description <DESCRIPTION>
          Free-text description stored with it

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
